QuestInfo.name: Lacking Resources
QuestInfo.0: #p3001101# informs you of the next mission and asks you to talk to him once you're ready. You're always ready!
QuestInfo.1: #p3001101# tells you that there aren't any animals at the central region, so gathering resources will be difficult. You need to gather supplies from the forest region and bring 50 #b#t4033420##k, #b#t4000744##k, and #b#t4000741##k items back to #b#p3001008##k. Get the items quickly so you can follow Kaiser to #p3001002#!\n\n#bDinodons and Yellow Speeyors#k can be found at #m401020400# and #bDinogoths#k can be found at #m401030000#.
QuestInfo.2: Looks like the central region has been stabilized. You should follow Kaiser and go see #p3001002#.

0.0: Maroon and Harpoon need some supplies before we get going. Could you get #b50 #t4033420#, #t4000744#, and #t4000741##k each? Harpoon'll be more than happy to see you, I'm sure.\r\n\r\n

yes.0: You'll do fine out there in the forest. Just go back to Harpoon when you're done.

no.0: Ah, you girls always take forever to get ready...

1.0: Oh wow, Angelic Buster! #p3001101# told me you were in charge of supplies. That means you're my boss! My beautiful, amazing, spectacular boss!

yes.0: You always bring me the best things. Is it because I'm your biggest fan, or because I am your number one fan? Probably both, huh? Oh, if you're looking for Kaiser, he went to talk to #b#p3001002##k.

item.0: Uh, we need some more. You must get #b50 #t4033420#, #t4000744#, and #t4000741##k each.
